title: Agency men say they follow the Varginha investigation

tellings.quote: and they're, "Oh, yeah. No, we know exactly what you've been doing."

plain: At an event he does not name, the documentary filmmaker James Fox was approached by agency men who told him they already knew all about his investigation into Varginha, a case in Brazil where the army is said to have captured a live alien. Fox tells Michels they said: "Oh, yeah. No, we know exactly what you've been doing," and he names someone called Leslie in the account. He tells it as a sign that his work was being watched.
